contract: See browser-qa.md: local chip scan map review with stored segmentation, skeleton, path, and motion artifacts.

accessibility.evidence: Chrome accessibility snapshot showed named regions and controls; Tab reached the import button with a visible focus ring, and the live DOM check found no unlabeled interactive controls.

responsive.evidence: At 1440x900, 390x844, and 340x740, the document width matched the viewport and the sample inspector reflowed below the map on mobile.

loading.evidence: A delayed sample-data fetch left the loading placeholder visible until the map and records completed loading.

empty.evidence: A custom image without coordinates showed zero scan records, an empty-record message, and a no-path response from playback.

error.evidence: Rejected sample-data requests showed a recovery action; reloading the stored sample restored the map.

partial.evidence: A custom map loaded without associated segmentation, skeleton, route, or motion data; metadata marked the data unassociated and unavailable layer controls were disabled.

success.evidence: The test4 and Map repository samples loaded their images, coordinates, and motion metadata in the browser.

permission.reason: This local review page has no account, role, or project-access gate.

renderedEvidence.observation: The rendered desktop view was visually reviewed: the navigation rail, map review canvas, path controls, and inspector fit in the viewport.
The rendered mobile view was visually reviewed: controls remain legible, the inspector flows below the map, and no horizontal overflow occurs.
